notes: One player as the monster against a team of survivors is the asymmetric 1 vs All case, and the answers confirm its exact win condition: survivors complete map objectives to unlock an exit and escape, so gate-escape stays rather than being dropped. The looping warren is the shape because the round is a chase and a dead end would hand the monster a free kill, and its P6 is a structural law here, not a cost to trim. The answer to build one compact template map keeps this a single build, so nothing earns P4 even though the finished game rotates maps. I read the map hazards as damaging regions and the monster as a player rather than AI, so hazard-kill carries the hazards and spawn-protected separates the monster and survivor starts; the ability decks, currency, cosmetics and spectator camera are systems rather than layout.
